headline: Bears survive five turnovers to beat Buccaneers on last-second field goal

top.headline: Bears survive five turnovers to beat Buccaneers on last-second field goal
top.summary: Caleb Williams threw four interceptions, but Cairo Santos hit a 38-yarder as time expired for a 27-24 Sunday night win, and Jaylon Johnson returned an interception 67 yards for a score. Chicago is 7-2 and leads the NFC North heading into its bye. Tampa Bay falls to 3-6.

top.headline: Puka Nacua set for MRI after knee injury on final snap
top.summary: Nacua hurt his knee on the Rams' last offensive play of a 20-13 win in Washington, after 14 catches for 150 yards and a touchdown. The team reportedly doesn't believe it's a torn ACL; Monday's imaging will tell. With Davante Adams already on IR, the Rams could shop for a receiver before Tuesday's deadline.

top.headline: Reaves scores 43 as Lakers win in Detroit without Doncic
top.summary: Austin Reaves scored 43, going 11 of 11 from the line, in a 121-116 win over the Pistons. Luka Doncic sat with lower-back tightness. Detroit has dropped two straight after a 6-1 start.

stories.headline: Bengals beat Falcons 34-17 in Madrid
stories.summary: Joe Burrow led four first-half scoring drives and Ja'Marr Chase had 10 catches for 155 yards and a touchdown. Cincinnati has scored 30-plus in four straight wins, a franchise first. The 6-2 Bengals are tied with Pittsburgh atop the AFC North.

stories.headline: Colts tell Daniel Jones he isn't being traded
stories.summary: Per NFL Network's Tom Pelissero, Indianapolis told Jones on Saturday he'll stay put. Minnesota had been linked to him after Kyler Murray was ruled out with a hamstring injury; Carson Wentz starts for the Vikings Monday night. The deadline is Tuesday at 4 p.m. ET.

stories.headline: Giants win in Philadelphia; Eagles lose seventh straight
stories.summary: New York beat Philadelphia 19-11 to move to 5-2-1, ending a 13-game losing streak in Philadelphia. The Eagles have lost seven in a row and are on their third quarterback with Jalen Hurts out for the season.

standouts.name: C.J. Stroud
standouts.note: Tied his career high with five TD passes in a 44-22 win over the Chargers.

standouts.name: Jordan Love
standouts.note: Also ran for a score as Green Bay won 45-27 as a 3.5-point underdog.

standouts.name: CeeDee Lamb
standouts.note: Targeted 16 times in a 27-23 win at Indianapolis.

leagues.name: NBA
leagues.summary: Reaves drops 43 in Detroit; Sixers 9-2; Clippers snap seven-game skid; Thunder add Nique Clifford

stories.headline: Reaves scores 43 as Lakers win in Detroit without Doncic
stories.summary: Austin Reaves scored 43, going 11 of 11 from the line, in a 121-116 win over the Pistons. Luka Doncic sat with lower-back tightness. Detroit has dropped two straight after a 6-1 start.

stories.headline: Thunder trade for Nique Clifford, waive Dalen Terry
stories.summary: Sacramento sent the second-year guard to Oklahoma City for two second-round picks; he had fallen out of the Kings' rotation. The Thunder waived Terry to make room while Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Chet Holmgren are out.

stories.headline: 76ers move to 9-2, best 11-game start since 2000-01
stories.summary: Philadelphia won 127-121 in Chicago behind Jaylen Brown's 29, Tyrese Maxey's 27 and a season-high 22 from LeBron James. The Sixers lead the East. The Bulls have lost seven straight.

stories.headline: Clippers end seven-game skid
stories.summary: The Clippers beat New Orleans 139-123 for their first win since opening night, with Darius Garland posting 24 points and 10 assists. Brandon Ingram (heel) is close to his Clippers debut.

stories.headline: Timberwolves win fourth straight; Jazz drop eighth in a row
stories.summary: Minnesota beat Utah 115-100 to reach 8-3, with Ayo Dosunmu scoring 26 while Anthony Edwards recovers from knee surgery. Utah, without Lauri Markkanen (wrist), is 1-9 and lost Keyonte George to a sprained ankle.

standouts.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
standouts.note: Shot 14 of 23 in a 114-108 win in Sacramento.

standouts.name: Cooper Flagg
standouts.note: Career-high 12 assists in a 130-93 rout of Brooklyn.

standouts.name: Josh Giddey
standouts.note: Came in a 127-121 loss to Philadelphia.

moves.text: Kings trade G Nique Clifford to the Thunder for two second-round picks (Nov. 8)

leagues.name: NHL
leagues.summary: Scheifele wins it with 1.6 seconds left; Gauthier's third hat trick in five games; Hellebuyck blanks Toronto

stories.headline: Scheifele scores with 1.6 seconds left as Jets edge Lightning
stories.summary: Mark Scheifele scored on a 5-on-3 at 59:58 of the third for a 4-3 win after Tampa Bay erased a 3-0 deficit. NHL.com says it's the league's latest regulation winner since Feb. 14, 2023. Brayden Point left in the first period with an injury.

stories.headline: Gauthier scores third hat trick in five games
stories.summary: Cutter Gauthier had three goals and an assist in Anaheim's 5-2 win over Pittsburgh. NHL.com says he's the first player with three hat tricks in the first 10 days of a calendar month. The Ducks have won five straight.

stories.headline: Hellebuyck blanks Leafs as Devils win fifth straight
stories.summary: Connor Hellebuyck made 23 saves in a 4-0 win in Toronto, his first shutout with New Jersey. Per NHL.com, he's the first goalie to win his first five starts as a Devil. Timo Meier scored twice and Nico Hischier reached 500 career points.

standouts.name: Cutter Gauthier
standouts.note: His goal streak is at six games, with 13 goals in that span.

standouts.name: Connor Hellebuyck
standouts.note: First shutout with New Jersey, which has won five straight.

standouts.name: Jeremy Swayman
standouts.note: Stopped 40 of 41 in a 4-1 win over Florida.

stories.headline: BBWAA awards week opens with Rookie of the Year
stories.summary: Rookie of the Year is announced Monday, followed by Manager of the Year Tuesday, Cy Young Wednesday and MVP Thursday. AL finalists: Kevin McGonigle (Tigers), Parker Messick (Guardians), Payton Tolle (Red Sox). NL finalists: Carson Benge (Mets), Sal Stewart (Reds), JJ Wetherholt (Cardinals).
